english: You look over to a glowing torch, deep inside the gelatinous cube.
What's up with that?
Huh. Doesn't it feel like that torch has something to do with this weird gelatinous cube?
Could I actually reach the torch?
R-Push through the gel to reach the torch.
E-Hm.
It's a magic item.
A torch built to burn forever.
Some kind of magic item.
There are a lot of those around.
No. Could you?
Possibly.
No.
Of course. What do you think I am? Weak?
For once I agree.
Let me rephrase: could you do it without having your skin be dissolved by the gelatinous cube?
Skin is overrated.
Guess we'll have to find out.
I suppose you've got your armor instead.
Have I even seen your skin?
Let's change the subject.
The goblin lets out a deep sigh and looks across the surface of the jelly-monster.
The cube's weird. They're usually way more aggressive.
The fact that we can stand here no problem, means something's way off.
And I bet it's that torch.
Can you use your magic to grab it?
There are a handful of spells that could work here.
A protective shield, if you wish to fight through the acid.
Or Mage Hand. A possibility.
I could just push on through.
What do you think we should do?
Hm. Well, you'd have to find it then. I thought you clerics knew basic cantrips like that.
I mean, we've even got some goblins who know it. It's not rare.
The goblin cannot be allowed to denigrate you like this.
It's beneath The Cleric of Norvik.
Trembling. Anger.
Look, I lost some things in the river, okay?
Don't bully me.

So I'm admitting to you that I, in fact, do not know this basic cantrip, but I also make it clear that I want to find it so we can proceed here, yet you stand there, complaining about it. I know. I should have it. I don't.
Right, yeah. You had a thing.
Sorry.
He means it.
Oh. I didn't mean to come off as mean.
The goblin is taken aback.
Damn. I'm sorry, Cleric.
You made your point.
He didn't mean to make you feel bad.
Yeah, well. Don't.
No worries. I just got a little emotionally upset. In a manly way.
Right. Fine.
Right. Good.
I do prefer manly expressions of emotion instead of... manly expressions of violence.
I think I like the violence more.
Same.
(Just flex a bit.)
He lifts his chin.
Anyway.
Good. Do that.
You would have to do that in that case.
By casting it. Instead of focusing on this.
With... what? Magic protection?
I'm a man, Snell. I can handle a little pain.
Yeah, something like that.
Ah, yes. A real man. Who can handle having his outer layer peeled off.
Exactly.
I might have to rethink this.
He rubs his temples.
For now, let's just... not do anything rash.
It does.
It's hard to say.
Warmth.
It is drawn to it.
Not sure what you'd do about it, though.
If you'd be able to reach it, maybe you'd find out more.
But that'd require you to... you know. Go inside.
Unless you were to locate Mage Hand. Perhaps you could find a copy of it somewhere upstairs.
Or, perhaps use Mage Hand.
The Cube will let you walk into it. However...
It will clamp onto you quickly. So you need to move as fast as you can, before it decides to hold you tight.
How far will you be able to get?
If you manage to move far enough while inside, then you could reach it.
You grit.
Your teeth.
You rush head on into the wall of gel.
It is letting you through. With zero resistance.
Anyone would be forgiven for just walking into this without noticing.
GO. QUICK.
If you're gonna do something dumb like this, you better move!
(Rush through the gel.)
You push yourself forward, and just seconds after being completely consumed, you feel the gel start to tighten.
Just a bit further...!
Almost.
Come on...!
You are almost at the torch.
You see it before you.
The translucent gel holding you back, your hand just inches away from the torch.
SKIN. MELTING.
The pain... is too great.
Your body... falters.
(Scream.)
Get through the pain.
You cannot. The gel is in your mouth.
The pain... is nothing.
You can... do this.
(Keep moving...)
One... step...
(Grab the torch.)
NO.
You fight it, but the Cube just keeps squeezing and covering you in that burning devilish substance.
IT IS TOO MUCH.
You cannot hear the goblin yelling beyond the gel.
You are here. Just you.
But you can.
You always could.
The mage hand quickly grabs the torch, and flies it through the gel towards you.
The speed of it is clearly faster than the Cube can react. Nice.
It lands in your hand. You feel the rough and gel-covered surface stick to your glove.
With the torch in your hand, you feel the esoteric tingle...
(Turn off the torch.)
The click reverberates through the Cube.
Then it shudders.
What's happening?
Oh. Oh gods, it's getting mad!
(Look around.)
You see the Gelatinous Cube shake, more violently for every passing second.
It is searching for... heat.
Within the Cube, you see what could only be described as... cracks.
It appears to be falling asunder.
Flopping and jerking, the many pieces of the Cube are flung across the chamber.
Ah. This explains it.
This is not a Cube.
Dividing. Dividing. Dividing.
Smaller pieces smashed against the walls of the chamber, causing a terrible tremor.
A ballet of goop.
Until, ultimately...
Each and every piece has escaped into the ventilation slits.
You are covered in it. It burns.
Get it off! Quick!
(Clean yourself off.)
The goblin carefully steps up to you, looking around.
Didn't expect that. Seriously, great job.
You see the last pieces of goop slip down into the cracks near the walls.
What actually happened here?
I don't doubt it.
Gelatinous Cubes are able to unite for a short duration.
However, if more than two were to pack together, the combination would become unstable within seconds.
What happened here was obvious. A multitude of cubes all came together to enjoy the endless heat coming from the Rûn-Torch.
The heat, or perhaps due to some cosmological chance, the unity of cubes found an equilibrium. Which was then disturbed once you turned off the heat source.
Half a dozen Cubes, stacked together.
This type of ooze usually never unite, and if so they only do so in small quantities.
This must have been some type of strange magic. Or an esoteric event.
The Cube sure dropped a lot of stuff around the place.
Let's see if there's anything interesting.
You hear excitement in his voice.
He clears his throat. "Related to the tea shop, that is."
The goblin wants some LOOT! Who can blame him?
There are pouches spread around the chamber. Perhaps magic items left behind by previous victims.
E-Cool. Loot.
